name: brud
description: Brud foundation: kernel, daemon, services, plugins, protocols, and contracts.
author: Rahat Hasan

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/kernel/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/services/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/daemon/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:ci: tsc -p packages/kernel/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/services/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/daemon/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:daemon && npm run test:cli
scripts.build:all: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:kernel && npm run build:sdk && npm run build:services && npm run build:daemon && npm run build:cli && npm run build:ui
scripts.ci: npm run build:all && npm run test:kernel && npm run test:cli && npm run check:boundaries && npm run lint
scripts.docs:api: cd docs/kernel-api && typedoc --options typedoc.json && node --import tsx tools/generate-catalogue.ts
